##### Project general facts

Pearl Beach View by Advanced Properties is a mid-rise residential building inspired by its setting on Lu'luat Al Raha Island, facing a sandy shoreline. The project offers studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and penthouses, complemented by select retail spaces at ground level. A modern, minimalist architecture with clean lines and carefully placed openings allows the building to sit naturally within its coastal setting, while selected residences are oriented towards the sea for open water views.

Amenities are planned around daily routines and a relaxed coastal lifestyle. Residents have access to a generously sized swimming pool with a separate kids' pool, a fully equipped gym and multipurpose rooms for yoga, private classes and light activities. A welcoming lobby and reception, dedicated resident parking and building-wide security with CCTV add comfort and peace of mind. The beach lies just a short walk away, bringing open-air walks and seaside moments into everyday life.

Interiors are open, practical and comfortable, with open-plan living and dining areas, generous ceiling heights and floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light and views. Generous balconies extend the living space outdoors. Selected homes feature built-in wardrobes, and bathrooms include walk-in showers with premium fittings. Each residence is shaped around functionality and flow, offering a calm, well-finished environment ready for the owner's own furniture.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Raha is a modern waterfront community in Abu Dhabi, known for its calm atmosphere, open spaces and high-quality urban planning. Lu'luat Al Raha Island sits within this setting, surrounded by marinas, landmark offices such as the Aldar headquarters and a sandy shoreline. The neighbourhood offers a balanced coastal lifestyle that remains practical and well connected to the wider city.

Residents have schools, cafes, restaurants, walking paths and marinas close at hand. Yas Island, with its leisure and entertainment attractions, lies a short drive away, as do Abu Dhabi International Airport and Downtown Abu Dhabi. Schools, universities, hospitals and clinics are within easy reach, making the area convenient for families as well as professionals working across the capital.

Al Raha is an established freehold destination that appeals to first-time buyers, families, investors and holiday home buyers alike. Its waterfront setting and strong connectivity support both short-term and long-term rental demand, and professional property management services are available to owners. The combination of coastal living and a mature community supports long-term ownership confidence.
